provenance.note: seed window for Pipeline V2 stage 10: two seconds either side of the boundary at two frames a second, the boundary index handed to the judge by the harness

questions.text: Does the boundary land inside a movement rather than after the movement has settled?
Does the action after the boundary continue the action before it as one unbroken movement?
Does screen direction hold across the boundary, with figures facing and moving the same way on both sides?
Does the image change across the boundary to a new setup, distance or piece of information?
